technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum deteriorating with negative MACD, bearish stoch cross, and price below key EMAs; low ADX suggests weak conviction and high false-breakout risk.

fundamental.summary: WELL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 20 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (389.12) with imminent FOMC event (0 days) and earnings in 20 days creates severe macro headwinds; normal yield curve provides minimal offset to acute volatility and policy uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA structure (50/200 bullish) and Ichimoku cloud positioning provide structural support, with extreme market fear (34/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity near support level 75.54.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below both 9 and 21-period EMAs with negative MACD momentum, bearish stochastic cross, zero volume confirmation (OBV not rising), weak ADX (14.38), imminent FOMC event, earnings in 20 days, and VIX crisis (389.12) create overwhelming near-term headwinds that invalidate structural bullish setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (75.54) and long-term EMA structure is bullish, the confluence of negative short-term momentum (MACD, stoch bearish cross), price below 9/21 EMAs, zero volume confirmation, and imminent FOMC event creates unacceptable near-term risk that outweighs contrarian opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (389.12) combined with FOMC event today and earnings in 20 days creates compounding macro and event risk; weak ADX (14.38) signals high false-breakout probability if support breaks.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
